## sb-checks (`tools/checks`, tool)

- `sb_checks` — AST convention checks: rules the linters cannot express, enforced on every PR.
- `sb_checks.__main__` — Allow ``python -m sb_checks``.
- `sb_checks.allowlist` — Justified exemptions from convention checks. Entries that excuse nothing are violations.
  - `class AllowEntry`
  - `class AllowlistError(ValueError)`
  - `def load_allowlist(file: Path) -> tuple[AllowEntry, ...]`
  - `def apply_allowlist(violations: Iterable[Violation], entries: Sequence[AllowEntry]) -> list[Violation]`
- `sb_checks.checks` — Registry of every convention check run by ``sb-checks run``.
- `sb_checks.checks.banned_module_names` — Module names must say what the module does; grab-bag names are banned.
  - `class BannedModuleNamesCheck`
- `sb_checks.checks.httpx_timeout` — Every outbound httpx call or client carries an explicit timeout (external I/O AP-1).
  - `class HttpxTimeoutCheck`
- `sb_checks.checks.no_env_read` — Environment variables are read only in the settings module (pydantic-settings).
  - `class NoEnvReadCheck`
- `sb_checks.checks.no_float` — Business math must use Decimal (sb_kernel.Money), never float (ADR-0015).
  - `class NoFloatCheck`
- `sb_checks.checks.no_member_tool_config` — Lint and type strictness live only in the root ruff.toml / pyrightconfig.json.
  - `class NoMemberToolConfigCheck`
- `sb_checks.checks.no_mock_in_unit` — Unit tests use in-memory fakes of ports (tests/<service>_fakes.py), never mocks.
  - `class NoMockInUnitCheck`
- `sb_checks.checks.no_naive_now` — Never read the wall clock directly; inject the sb_kernel Clock port instead.
  - `class NoNaiveNowCheck`
- `sb_checks.checks.use_case_rules` — Each use case lists its business rules R1..Rn; each rule has a test named test_R<n>_*.
  - `class UseCaseRulesCheck`
- `sb_checks.cli` — Command line entry point: ``run``, ``list``, ``doctor``, ``openapi`` and ``doc-commands``.
  - `def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None=None, probe: Probe | None=None) -> int`
- `sb_checks.core` — Core types shared by every convention check: violations, file context, the Check protocol.
  - `class Violation`
  - `class FileContext`
  - `class Check(Protocol)`
  - `class RepoCheck(Protocol)`
  - `def matches_any(path: PurePosixPath, patterns: Iterable[str]) -> bool`
  - `def iter_python_files(root: Path) -> Iterator[PurePosixPath]`
- `sb_checks.doc_commands` — `sb-checks doc-commands`: extract the executable blocks of a doc and optionally run them.
  - `class DocError(ValueError)`
  - `class BlockTimeoutError(RuntimeError)`
  - `def extract(markdown: str, tag: str=DEFAULT_TAG) -> list[str]`
  - `def run(blocks: list[str], root: Path, announce: Callable[[int, int, str], None] | None=None, timeout: float=BLOCK_TI...`
- `sb_checks.doctor` — Environment diagnostics for `make doctor`: tools, Docker, ports, dev secrets.
  - `class Finding`
  - `class Probe(Protocol)`
  - `class SystemProbe`
  - `def diagnose(probe: Probe, env: Mapping[str, str], compose: str=DEFAULT_COMPOSE) -> list[Finding]`
- `sb_checks.openapi` — `sb-checks openapi`: render a service's OpenAPI document and write or drift-check it.
  - `class ServiceNameError(ValueError)`
  - `def contract_path(root: Path, service: str) -> Path`
  - `def render(service: str) -> str`
  - `def write(root: Path, service: str) -> Path`

- `sb_checks.runner` — Run a set of checks over every Python file in the repo's code roots.
  - `def run_checks(root: Path, checks: Sequence[AnyCheck], allowlist: Sequence[AllowEntry]=()) -> list[Violation]`

## sb-kernel (`libs/py/sb_kernel`, lib)

- `sb_kernel` — Pure core types shared by every service (A2): money, errors, ids, time, context, events.
